_README: Players entered by hand from 号角 (web.haojiao.cc), for people vlr.gg and
Roster moves land here days or weeks before the English-language sites pick
them up, and a Chinese domestic player who has only ever played CN ES and
VCNT may never appear on them at all. Refusing to model such a player is
not neutrality — it leaves the club a man short and the game wrong.
Same rule as everywhere else: nothing is invented. Every field below is
read off the cited page. What that page does not publish is null, and the
world builder treats a null the way it treats any missing stat — as the
population median — rather than filling in a plausible number.
`stats` are 号角's 近三月统计. ADR, KAST, HS%, first-blood rates and a
composite rating are simply not published there, hence the nulls.

zhubibi.roleNote: All four agents are duelists, so 决斗者 is measured rather than guessed — 号角's own 位置 field is blank.
